_source: Department of Science & Technology (DST) NIDHI-TBI guidelines and IICE support-funding page
name: DST NIDHI-TBI Seed Support System
provider: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India
oneLiner: Early-stage seed assistance for physical incubatees at IICE to bridge prototype validation, IP filing, and initial market entry.

atAGlance.purpose: Product development, testing and trials, test marketing, mentoring, and statutory compliance
atAGlance.fundingAgency: NSTEDB, Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India
atAGlance.expectedOutput: Commercializable deep-tech product, validated customer pilots, and readiness for institutional capital
atAGlance.whoCanApply: Indian private limited startups physically incubated at IICE, IISER Bhopal for at least 3 months

benefits: Seed funding support ranging from ₹10 Lakh to ₹100 Lakh based on technology readiness and capital milestones
Access to IISER Bhopal wet/dry laboratories and Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) at internal incubatee rates
Dedicated faculty mentorship and IP filing facilitation
eligibility: Registered in India as a Private Limited Company with at least 51% shareholding by Indian citizens.
Physically incubated at IICE, IISER Bhopal with an innovative technology or science-led product.
Not a subsidiary or promoter-group spin-off of an existing large corporation.
coveredUses: Product development, lab consumables, and fabrication of functional prototypes.
Testing, clinical/field trials, certification, and Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) analytical charges.
Intellectual property filing, freedom-to-operate searches, and technology transfer fees.
Test marketing, early customer onboarding, and essential technical manpower.
nonPermittedUses: Purchase of land, real estate, or civil construction.
Repayment of prior promoter loans or unrelated corporate liabilities.

selectionSteps.label: Technical Due Diligence
selectionSteps.detail: Preliminary review by the IICE Incubation Manager and IISER Bhopal faculty mentor.

selectionSteps.label: Committee Pitch
selectionSteps.detail: Detailed pitch presentation and milestone review before the Evaluation Committee.

selectionSteps.label: Agreement & Tranche Release
selectionSteps.detail: Execution of seed support agreement and milestone-based disbursement.
